name: After The Divorce Im Unreachable
overview: Mateo, a man who is married to Sofía and is constantly despised by his in-laws. They force him to do household chores and compare him unfavorably to his brother-in-law, Lucas. Tired of Sofía's abuse and infidelities, Mateo decides to get divorced. What his in-laws don't know is that he is actually the secret heir to an immense fortune and a figure of great power, making him unattainable to those who previously humiliated him.
